title: Fastest UGC Agency Turnaround: Published Delivery Times Compared
summary: As of October 2026, Creatify Studio lists 48 hours and Brighter Click 10 to 14 business days. Compare published first-delivery times across UGC agencies.
body_markdown:
## Which creative tests suit a fast batch?


A fast batch suits tests that vary the hook, the opening problem or the offer while the product and the claim stay the same. Ask for concepts that each open on a different problem, then keep the strongest problem and send it back for more variants. That loop depends on the clock: in a four-week month, a weekly cadence allows four rounds of learning, while a 21-day first round allows one.


A slower creator batch suits a launch where the story depends on a real person's experience, such as a customer describing what changed after using the product. Those stories need casting, briefing and footage that cannot be rushed without weakening the claim. Match the clock to the job: a short calendar for hook tests, and a longer creator calendar for stories that must be true.


## When is speed the wrong test?


A fast AI UGC batch is still scripted advertising. An AI presenter cannot give a real customer's testimonial, and it cannot run partnership ads from a creator's handle. Meta's[partnership ads documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/ad-creative/partnership-ads) describes these ads as running from a creator's or other partner's handle, which an AI presenter cannot provide.


As of October 2026, the[FTC's testimonials rule questions and answers](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/consumer-reviews-testimonials-rule-questions-answers) says there is no blanket ban on AI avatars in marketing. An avatar is prohibited, however, when the testimonial it delivers is fake or false. If the claim needs a real person's experience, a slower real-creator agency is the right kind of provider, even though its clock is longer. Our guide to[best AI UGC agencies](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ai-ugc-agencies) covers the AI side of that choice.


## What should you ask about turnaround?


Ask for three dates in writing: when the first batch ships, when the approvals are due from your team, and when the next batch arrives. A published render or delivery time may not include scripting, casting, approvals or your review, so ask which steps the figure covers. Ask whether a script change or a new presenter restarts the clock.


If you test new hooks every week, the number that matters is the cadence after the first delivery. Ask how many new concepts arrive each week, and how many approved ads you can run in the same period. For an ongoing test, the weekly rhythm matters as much as the first date. To price that rhythm for your brand,[book a call](https://knowlify.com/book) .


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for AI UGC ads on a steady clock: a first batch on day five and about 25 finished ads a week, each checked by a person.
- As of October 2026, Creatify Studio lists a 48-hour turnaround, and Unreal UGC lists 3 to 5 days.
- Real-creator agencies quote longer: Brighter Click's 12-video package runs 10 to 14 business days, and The UGC Agency targets 21 days for its first round.
- Confirm where each clock starts and which steps it covers before you compare them.
- Speed does not replace a real customer's testimonial or a partnership ad, so choose a real-creator agency when those formats matter.


## FAQ


### Which UGC agency is the fastest?


Knowlify is our top pick for AI UGC, with a first batch on day five and about 25 finished ads a week. Among the published figures we checked, Creatify Studio lists the shortest turnaround, 48 hours as of October 2026. Confirm each start point and what the figure covers before you choose.


### How long do real-creator UGC agencies take?


Published figures vary. Brighter Click's 12-video package lists 10 to 14 business days, UGC Factory lists 3-week delivery on its Performance package, and minisocial's campaigns typically run 4 to 6 weeks from briefing to completed content. The UGC Agency targets 21 days for its first round of finished ads.


### Does a faster AI UGC agency give the same ads as real creators?


No. An AI presenter is not a real customer, and it cannot run partnership ads from a creator's handle. Choose by the claim and the format the ad needs, then use speed as a tiebreaker.


### What should I ask for in writing about turnaround?


Ask for the first delivery date, your approval deadlines and the date of the next batch. Ask whether a script change or a new presenter restarts the clock. Get the answers in the proposal, not only on a call.
